data.headline: PPL boosts domestic hydrocarbon output:
data.summary: PPL has achieved a significant increase in hydrocarbon production across its wells nationwide, reaffirming its commitment to bolstering the country’s energy security.

data.headline: PPL makes third discovery in Sujawal:
data.summary: Sindh Minister for Planning and Development and Energy Syed Nasir Hussain Shah has announced a major discovery of gas and condensate in Sujawal.

data.headline: PPL secures development lease extension for Sui gas field:
data.summary: PPL has received approval for a development and production lease over the sui gas field, covering an area of 455.8 square kms, for a period of 10 years, effective from June 1, 2015 to May 31, 2025, the company announced.

data.headline: PPL expands oil and gas production with Adhi South-9 well:
data.summary: PPL, a key player in the oil and gas exploration sector, has announced the commencement of hydrocarbon production from its newly developed well, Adhi South-9, located in Punjab’s Pothwar region.

data.headline: PPL announces gas discovery in Sindh
data.summary: PPL said that it had made a gas discovery at the exploratory well Tor-1 in Latif Block, located in Khairpur District, Sindh.

data.headline: PPL seeks revision in prices of gas from Kandhkot field
data.summary: Pakistan Petroleum Limited (PPL) has sought revision in gas prices for additional recovery of 100 BCF gas from Kandhkot Gas Field.

data.headline: PPL to fund Balochistan’s share of lead-zinc project
data.summary: Pakistan Petroleum Limited (PPL) said on Tuesday it had agreed to fund the government of Balochistan’s share of capital contribution in a lead-zinc mining and processing project in the province.
